inv.desc_en:
Arty Consultores rents a magnificent commercial space for sublease in Vallehermoso, at 3 Julian Romea Street, in the heart of the Chamberí neighborhood. 375m2, on two floors, last activity was a bank branch, completely open-plan, 3.5m ceiling height, large storefront, community fees included.

Assets under a sublease regime (S&LB). The property is owned by a third party and is currently leased; it is being published by the tenant to offer the space for sublease. It is not possible to provide the master lease agreement, and the owner's authorization is required to sublease. Specific rental conditions:

1. Rent-free period: 2 months of rent.
2. Ordinary rent adjustment: Annual based on the CPI (Consumer Price Index).
3. Extraordinary rent review for market adjustment starting from the 5th year: Market review every 5 years.
4. Mandatory compliance period: 5 years.
5. Total term: Duration of the master contract minus 3 months.
6. Common expenses and IBI (Property Tax): Paid by the lessor.
7. Legal deposit: 2 months of rent.
8. Additional guarantee: 2-4 months of rent must be provided as a deposit, depending on the results of the scoring process.

Commercial area with schools, local shops, supermarkets, and a residential zone.

Very well connected by metro and buses.

If you would like to see other properties in our portfolio, please visit our website at artyconsultores. com.
